content: Render free web service: 512MB RAM, 0.1 vCPU (a tenth of one core), 750 instance-hours/month shared across free services, spins down after 15 min idle causing 30-60s cold start on next request (no config option to prevent this on free tier). Free Postgres add-on is deleted after 90 days. App must bind to  env var. Acceptable for portfolio/low-traffic demos; explicitly not for services expecting always-warm responses.
